description: VC-BLD-05: chord-2 fillet (mode chord) on a 60 degree edge of an equilateral prism of side 10 and depth 10
formula: r = c / (2 cos(a/2)) = 2 / sqrt(3) = 1.154701; V = prism - r^2 (cot(a/2) - (pi - a)/2) L with a = pi/3; the rounded 60 degree corner moves the bbox minimum x to 2 - r = 0.845299
